net_definition: One fixed account policy, executable orders, all configured costs and held-position valuation; no annualization substitute for the 2026 interval.
requested_2026_end: last actual exchange session on or before 2026-10-31
selection_rule: Economic hypothesis and rule choices use independent sources and pre-2026 development only; fixed 2026 diagnostics must not tune later variants.
no_lookahead_red_line: 不要测试区间的事实去反推方法
claim_boundary: Historical simulation is not realized account profit. No broker orders are authorized or submitted by this project.
completion_requires: Same frozen method satisfies all three specified net-return conditions
Complete requested date coverage or explicit user acceptance of an interim cutoff
Price/data/source/policy/evaluator hashes and reproducible decision/execution ledger
Honest labeling of consumed 2026 diagnostics and point-in-time data limitations
